changelog:
- Open Facebook Link Feature: Direct deep-link injection button ('Open FB Link') and context menu options to open any Facebook post or share link directly inside the Facebook app on selected emulators.
- Automatic Name Sync on Backup: Automatically retrieves and updates the account's latest display Name in the app table every time a backup is performed, using the emulator's secure VPN tunnel.
- OpenVPN Reliability & Persistence: Restructured the Restore Backup pipeline so device identity and profile setup complete before VPN initialization, ensuring OpenVPN connections remain steady without dropping.
- Battery Optimization Whitelisting: Added system-level battery optimization and background execution whitelisting for OpenVPN to prevent low memory killers from disconnecting the VPN.
- App Launching Focus: Improved foreground focus handling to ensure the Facebook app opens cleanly on top of all emulators after restore operations.
